places.name: FlowbindBalance
places.description: One accounting snapshot of quality-released usable units and still-open PO units. Indian receipt subtracts open units, matched quality clearance adds released units, and production start consumes released units. Quarantine is excluded; German receipt and expiry remain unmodelled.

places.name: FlowbindReviewDue
places.description: External review event; schedule is not yet known. One event permits one purchasing decision.

places.name: IndianAcceptingOrders
places.description: Externally set supplier availability. One token means Indian Supplier can accept an order; its outage and restoration are not generated here.

places.name: IndianOpenFlowbindOrders
places.description: Indian Supplier Flowbind POs whose full quantity remains open until a matched external arrival event closes the order and sends its lot to quarantine.

places.name: GermanUrgentThresholdEvent
places.description: Externally supplied event from ongoing monitoring of released stock; no review meeting needed. Generation/deduplication is outside the partial net.

places.name: GermanFlowbindTopupRequests
places.description: Requests for an approximately 250-unit German bridge; not treated as accepted orders or usable supply.

places.name: IndianFlowbindArrival
places.description: External physical arrival signal carrying the matching order identity and full ordered quantity; timing is not yet generated.

places.name: FlowbindInQuarantine
places.description: Full received Flowbind lots excluded from usable stock and from inventory position until quality disposition.

places.name: FlowbindQualityCleared
places.description: Externally supplied matching signal that quality cleared the entire quarantined lot; no completion timing is generated.

places.name: FlowbindQualityRejected
places.description: Externally supplied matching signal that quality rejected the entire quarantined lot; no failure probability or duration is inferred.

places.name: FlowbindDisposed
places.description: Rejected full Flowbind lots sent to disposal, preserving standard-unit amounts; monetary loss not measured.

places.name: SonaflozinUsableStock
places.description: Usable Sonaflozin units available for batch start; its replenishment and quality processes are outside this partial net.

places.name: SonicFlowPlannedBatches
places.description: Externally supplied batches entered at their original due start, with wait_seconds initially zero. Waiting age grows until enough of both materials permits immediate full start; planning schedule is not generated.

places.name: SonicFlowInProgress
places.description: Batches started after consuming both full material quantities; completion duration and finished output are not yet represented.

transitions.name: Place Indian Flowbind replenishment order
transitions.description: On external review when Indian Supplier accepts orders, create a PO to the approximate target at Indian MOQ multiples if inventory position is below approximate reorder point. Later physical receipt requires a matching external arrival event; lead time is not generated.

transitions.name: Complete Flowbind review without replenishment
transitions.description: Consumes a review event when the inventory position is at or above the reorder point; leaves balances untouched.
transitions.lambdaCode:
const balance = input.FlowbindBalance[0];
return balance.released_units + balance.open_units >= parameters.flowbind_reorder_point;
transitions.transitionKernelCode:
const balance = input.FlowbindBalance[0];
return { FlowbindBalance: [{ released_units: balance.released_units, open_units: balance.open_units }] };

transitions.name: Indian Supplier cannot accept Flowbind order
transitions.description: On a due review below reorder point, if Indian Supplier cannot accept orders the review ends without an Indian PO. The distinct urgent German request may occur separately on a below-500 monitoring event; acceptance and delivery are unmodelled.
transitions.lambdaCode:
const balance = input.FlowbindBalance[0];
return balance.released_units + balance.open_units < parameters.flowbind_reorder_point;
transitions.transitionKernelCode:
const balance = input.FlowbindBalance[0];
return { FlowbindBalance: [{ released_units: balance.released_units, open_units: balance.open_units }] };

transitions.name: Request urgent German Flowbind bridge
transitions.description: Consumes externally supplied urgent monitoring event when released stock is below 500 and Indian Supplier cannot accept an order. Emits a request only; acceptance and supply are unmodelled.

transitions.name: Receive full Indian Flowbind order into quarantine
transitions.description: On matched external physical-arrival event, closes one full Indian PO and removes its quantity from inventory position; preserves full lot in quarantine without increasing usable stock.

transitions.name: Release full Flowbind lot after quality clearance
transitions.description: On matching external quality-clearance result, consumes the entire quarantined lot and adds all its units to released usable stock in the planning balance.

transitions.name: Reject and dispose of full Flowbind lot
transitions.description: On matching external failed quality result, consumes the whole quarantined lot and records its quantity as disposed, not released or returned to supplier.
transitions.transitionKernelCode:
const lot = input.FlowbindInQuarantine[0];
return { FlowbindDisposed: [{ units: lot.units, order_id: lot.order_id }] };

transitions.name: Start full Sonic Flow production batch
transitions.description: As soon as both full usable material quantities are available, starts an externally due batch, consumes one unit of each per Sonic Flow unit, and carries its planned-to-actual-start waiting age into in-progress state. Step resolution, production completion and output remain unmodelled.

types.name: Flowbind planning balance
types.description: Released usable stock and open-order quantity in consistent standard units; quarantine is excluded.

types.name: Flowbind purchase order
types.description: One Flowbind order or received lot in standard units, with an identity for matching order, arrival and quarantine; German request is not yet an accepted order.

metrics.name: Usable Flowbind units
metrics.description: Current quality-released Flowbind stock in standard units; a reported state measure, not fill rate or production service.
metrics.code:
const balance = state.places.FlowbindBalance.tokens;
return balance.length === 0 ? 0 : balance[0].released_units;

metrics.name: Started-batch total start delay (days)
metrics.description: Sum of planned-to-actual-start waiting days for batches currently in progress; excludes still-waiting and completed batches, so it is not total service delay.
